items.author: marieke.vandenbroek@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Launch run of show - Thursday 26 November
items.body: Event: launch of 'Who Pays at the Border? CBAM revenues and the least developed countries'. Host: MEP Katarina Lindqvist. Venue: European Parliament, Altiero Spinelli building, room booked by Lindqvist office. Guests must be at the security entrance by 12:00, badges collected by Tomás. 12:30 welcome Lindqvist (5 min). 12:35 presentation Marieke (20 min). 12:55 panel: Dr. Abena Owusu-Mensah (Accra Trade Policy Centre, remote), Florian Kessler (Alliance of European Steel Users), Marieke. Moderator Lindqvist. 13:40 Q&A. 14:00 close. Light lunch outside the room from 12:00.

items.author: tomas.reyes@ep-office-lindqvist.example
items.title: Thursday - small change to timings
items.body: Dear Marieke, apologies for the late change. The MEP has a vote moved into Thursday lunchtime and will have to leave at 13:30. Could the presentation be 15 minutes instead of 20, and could we start the panel at 12:50? She would like to take at least two questions herself before she goes. Badges: I need the final names of anyone from your side by Wednesday 12:00 latest, otherwise security will not let them in. Best regards, Tomás

items.author: marieke.vandenbroek@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: ERROR figure 3 - must fix before launch
items.body: Found it this afternoon. Figure 3 and the summary use the 2030 revenue estimate from the old run (free allocation phase-out not applied). Correct number for 2030 LDC-relevant revenue is EUR 1.4 billion, not EUR 2.1 billion. PDF v7 on the drive is corrected (pages 3, 14, 15). NOT yet corrected: slides (deck v4, slides 6 and 9) and the embargoed press release Hanna sent to journalists on Friday, which says 2.1. Embargo lifts Thursday 10:00. Conclusion of the paper does not change, but the headline number does.

items.author: hanna.weber@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Press release out under embargo
items.body: Hi Marieke, the release went to our 34 Brussels contacts this afternoon, embargoed until Thursday 26 Nov 10:00 CET. Two journalists asked for a call before the event, one from a trade newsletter and one from a Belgian daily, I said you would be available Wednesday afternoon. Let me know if you want me to do anything else. Hanna

items.author: florian.kessler@aesu.example
items.title: Comments on draft (AESU)
items.body: Thank you for sharing the draft. Our main concern is the assumption in section 4 that downstream steel users can pass through 80% of the border cost. Our members report this is much lower for small manufacturers. We also think the paper underestimates the risk of resource shuffling. We will raise this at the panel. Kind regards, Florian Kessler, Alliance of European Steel Users

items.author: marieke.vandenbroek@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Reply lines for Kessler
items.body: Pass-through 80% is the central case, sensitivity in annex B runs 40% and 60%, result holds at 60%, weakens at 40%. Say this openly, do not get defensive. Resource shuffling: we agree it is a risk, section 5.2, we recommend the Commission's monitoring report. Abena will probably back us on the LDC side, she was strong on the call.

items.author: lucy.tran@halvorsen-foundation.example
items.title: Looking forward to Thursday
items.body: Dear Marieke, I will attend the launch with my colleague. For our grant report we will need two photos from the event and the attendance numbers, ideally by 4 December. Congratulations to you and Inês on getting this finished. Warm wishes, Lucy Tran, Programme Officer

items.author: sanne.vandenbroek@mailbox.example
items.title: papa
items.body: Mariek, ze zeggen nu herseninfarct, links. Hij ligt op de IC in de Gelderse Vallei in Ede. Hij praat nog niet goed. Mama is hier, ze is helemaal op. Kun je vanavond nog komen? De arts wil morgen om 9 uur met de familie praten. Bel me als je in de trein zit. Sanne

items.author: geert.lammens@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: CONFIDENTIAL - programme funding 2027
items.body: Marieke, for you only for now. Halvorsen have told me informally they may not renew the core grant after June 2027. If not, we are looking at a gap of about EUR 380,000 and I will try to find bridge funding from the board. Please do not discuss with the team before I have spoken to them in December. Geert

items.author: ines.carvalho@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Deck v4 notes
items.body: Marieke, I made the deck shorter like you asked, 14 slides now. Slide 9 has the revenue chart. I left your speaker notes in. The remote link for Abena is in the calendar invite, she tested it yesterday and it works. Inês

items.author: marieke.vandenbroek@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Press calls (Hanna to confirm)
items.body: Wednesday 25 Nov, 14:00 and 15:00, journalists' background calls on the report. Phone, 20 min each.

items.author: marieke.vandenbroek@scheldt-institute.example
items.title: Ideas for 2027 work plan
items.body: Possible next paper: CBAM and the Western Balkans, talk to Inês about leading it. Also the ETS2 social climate fund tracker, maybe with the Warsaw partners. Need to decide by January.
